FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.description: Everything you need to know about VoiceForge AI text-to-speech

items.question: What is text-to-speech (TTS) and how does VoiceForge work?
items.answer: Text-to-speech (TTS) is technology that converts written text into spoken audio. VoiceForge uses advanced AI neural networks to analyze your text and generate natural-sounding speech. Simply paste your text, select a voice and language, then download the audio file.

items.question: How many languages and voices does VoiceForge support?
items.answer: VoiceForge supports 30+ languages including English, Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, French, German, Korean, and more. We offer 50+ unique AI voices with different genders, ages, and speaking styles to match any content type.

items.question: What audio formats can I export?
items.answer: You can export generated speech as MP3 (ideal for web, social media, and mobile) or WAV (lossless quality for professional audio production). Both formats support adjustable bitrate settings on paid plans.

items.question: Is there a free trial for VoiceForge TTS?
items.answer: Yes! New users receive free credits to try VoiceForge. You can convert up to 5,000 characters per month on the free plan. Upgrade to a paid plan for higher limits, premium voices, and API access.

items.question: Can I use VoiceForge audio for commercial projects?
items.answer: Yes. All audio generated on paid plans comes with a commercial use license. You can use the audio in YouTube videos, podcasts, audiobooks, advertisements, and any other commercial project without attribution.

items.question: How is VoiceForge different from other TTS tools?
items.answer: VoiceForge combines cutting-edge neural TTS with an intuitive interface and developer-friendly API. Unlike robotic legacy TTS, our AI voices sound natural with proper intonation and emotion. We also offer SSML support, batch processing, and 30+ languages in one platform.

items.question: Does VoiceForge offer an API for developers?
items.answer: Yes. Our REST API lets developers integrate text-to-speech into any application. Send text via HTTP request and receive audio URLs in response. API documentation, SDKs, and webhook support are available on Pro and Enterprise plans.

items.question: Is my text data safe and private?
items.answer: Absolutely. All text and audio is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256). We never use your content to train AI models. Generated files are auto-deleted after 30 days unless you explicitly save them to your account.
